caption: Back-projecting f gives b: the two cells that should be 0 pick up 2 each, and the total is 10 instead of 2. That 1/r blur is what the ramp filter |ω| removes before back-projection.

spec.title: Unfiltered back-projection (3 views)
spec.aria: Two 2x2 grids: the true object f with 1 on its diagonal and 0 off it, and its unfiltered back-projection b with 3 on the diagonal and 2 off it, showing the blur that the ramp filter removes.
